name: Zero-Result Search Query Relaxation (Strict AND -> Loose OR Fallback)
description: If a multi-word search query (e.g. 'ergonomic mechanical wireless split keyboard') returns zero results under strict AND matching, modern engines gracefully relax to OR matching.
prompt:
If a multi-word search query (e.g. 'ergonomic mechanical wireless split keyboard') returns zero results under strict AND matching, modern engines gracefully relax to OR matching.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: id, title, match_score, match_tier.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Query tokens: 'ergonomic', 'mechanical', 'wireless'
            WITH scored_matches AS (
                SELECT 
                    id,
                    title,
                    (CASE WHEN title ILIKE '%ergonomic%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                     CASE WHEN title ILIKE '%mechanical%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
                     CASE WHEN title ILIKE '%wireless%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS match_score
                FROM keyboard_catalog
            )
            SELECT 
                id,
                title,
                match_score,
                CASE WHEN match_score = 3 THEN 'STRICT_ALL_MATCH' ELSE 'RELAXED_PARTIAL_MATCH' END AS match_tier
            FROM scored_matches
            WHERE match_score >= 1
            ORDER BY match_score DESC, id;
why_it_fails: Failing to return fallback results leads to user bounce and abandoned sessions.
